comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is most similar (35.7%) to Ci-MAM-A24. Activity: MIC assays using gram-positive strains, S. aureus ATCC 6538 (MIC 0.41 uM), Bacillus cereus ATCC 10876 (MIC 1.66 uM), and E. faecalis ATCC 29212 (MIC 0.55 uM), and 3 gram-negative strains, E. coli ATCC 25922 (MIC 1.38 uM). Also: inhibit West Nile virus (WNV) replication in primary keratinocytes. MOA:bacteria: permeate (TO-PRO-3 iodide) and depolarize (DiOC2(3)) bacterial membranes. In vitro toxicity: Showed some toxicity to HEK293T, Human primary keratinocytes and MCF7 at 32 uM. Structure: This peptide is even helical in aqueous solution. With two negative bands at 208 and 222 nm, this peptide is more helical than ModoCath1 with only a minimum at 208 nm.
